MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_GEINIZHENGYIPOWER.des: This round, every time a friendly player draws a card and recovers it{energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}Then give it 1 layer of justice
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_SILENT_POWER.title: Silence
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_SILENT_POWER.descript: Right-click to spend 13 [color=#6666cc]Silence[/color]: all enemies immediately perform their current intent, then become stunned. Their next intent after the stunned turn is replaced by a player-beneficial intent.
